images.caption: Former Bellingham City Hall, now part of the Whatcom Museum. The lovingly restored city council chambers is used for many museum and community events. The jail in this city hall did not have any showers, therefore the inmates had to be taken outdoors and hosed down by the firemen in the adjacent fire station.
images.alt: Former Bellingham City Hall, now part of the Whatcom Museum. The lovingly restored city council chambers is used for many museum and community events. The jail in this city hall did not have any showers, therefore the inmates had to be taken outdoors and hosed down by the firemen in the adjacent fire station.
